The main takeaway from our work is that
SSL methods are able to learn representations that are both expressive and learnable, and that this is the main driver behind their success.
SSL methods should both be learnable and expressive to be effective.
SSL algorithms should be evaluated not only in the context of downstream classification tasks but also in terms of the learnability and expressiveness of the representations.
